verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents an official MCP server through which agents such as Claude Code and Codex can read and change the Model (formulas, Variables, Tables, Pages), including updating this month's forecast. Every Model change is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone, the same trail used for human edits, because clients act as the signed-in person. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent edits appear in the changelog, explicit evidence of scenario-specific MCP operations, and any marking that tells agent edits apart from human edits in the audit trail (no OpenAPI spec was found either).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can build or update a forecast or scenario through a documented machine interface, and the change lands in the same audit trail as a human edit

citations.quote: AI clients such as Claude Code and Codex can work on your Model through the cfo.ai MCP server.
an agent can read a company's financial Model and, when the user asks, change it: Pages, Table blocks, Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables, Dimensions
